Zamorak's damage and HP scales with enrage, and additional mechanics are introduced at specific enrage thresholds:
, all players must be on their rune at the same time to exit Infernus
, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 50% adrenaline and the first ability is Asphyxiate
, demons will move faster towards the portal
healing ramp-up no longer resets between phases
, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 100% adrenaline and their first ability is Omnipower
On phase 7, red bar charge is no longer reset between cycle(s)
On phase 7, Zamorak's life points cap at 250,000 per player
The life points of chaos demons cap at 70,000 while on Infernus
During the Adrenaline Cage attack, the targeted player will have their Devotion
Zamorak's stagger after killing a rune on Phase 7 reduced from 10 to 5 ticks
For phases 1-6, Zamorak's starting life points cap at 1,600,000 per player
On phase 7, the life points the runes revive with are capped at 60,000
